main_text.p: Wallo, Possedit: & wfelde, possedisti] Eidem origini (forte) referenda hæc,ac waldan sal, supra, quod vide.
Wilfonodon, Tribulaverunt: & wlfinunf, tribulant: alibi wlfinunf, & wiffinunda, tribulantes] Vide Gewiffenon, supra.
Weigoden, Vexaverunt] Vox (ni fallor) conflata ex Belg. wee, Sax. pap, nobis woe, dolor, miseria, (de quo supra in Gewetgit) & geden, quod à doen fluens, facere sonat.
Wedan sal, Induam. supra Waf] Quod vide.

page.notes: Black letter words in the entries are rendered in bl tags; several are uncertain (for example "wlfinunf", "wiffinunda", "Gewetgit") and may contain misreadings. The faint ghost text in the lower half of the page is show-through and was not transcribed.
